messages:
jules: Heads up — prepping a set of lightweight Terraform stubs for CloudPartnerX onramp. Want a quick review before we publish to the refkit repo. Goals: minimal, opinionated, includes an ARM/Graviton sample, and a tiny smoke test.

maria: love the goals. do we have a target directory structure? trying to keep parity with other partners but keep it small.

devon: suggest: /terraform/stubs/cloudpartnerx/{network, compute, examples}. Keep modules tiny, point to our longform refarch for advanced uses.

ashok: please include explicit comments about quantized model artifacts + KMS key examples. partners often ask where to put model weights for private deploy.

jules: agreed. plan is: one main module that wires networking + optional dedicated GPU pool, then two example overlays: x86 (g4dn) and graviton (t4g) with notes on perf/limits.

maria: can you paste the example snippet you plan to include? quick glance would help.

jules: sure — will include this example in README and examples/quickstart/main.tf:

```hcl
module "redwood_inference" {
  source        = "github.com/redwood/refkit/terraform/stubs/cloudpartnerx"
  region        = var.region
  instance_type = var.use_graviton ? "t4g.xlarge" : "g4dn.xlarge"  # graviton vs nvidia example
  dedicated_gpu = var.dedicated_gpu
}

variable "use_graviton" {
  type    = bool
  default = false
}
```

maria: nice — add a tiny smoke script in examples/ that runs a single generate call and checks latency < 3s for the stub model. we can keep the model a tiny dummy or local mock.

devon: +1. also include a quick CI job that runs `terraform init && terraform apply -auto-approve` against a free-tier test account and then `./examples/quickstart/smoke.sh`. make the CI optional (flagged as integration) so it doesn't block main PRs.

marketplace-bot: Repository created: github.com/redwood/refkit/tree/stubs/cloudpartnerx — initial branch skeleton. (bot note) link: https://github.com/redwood/refkit/tree/stubs/cloudpartnerx

ashok: for KMS example, do NOT hardcode ARNs. show a variable and a comment like: `# pass customer_kms_key_id for private deploys`. also mention HSM for private customers.

jules: good call — we'll add a section in README: security considerations + deployment modes. also include a short blurb for partner enablement doc explaining the quick checklist: 1) run smoke, 2) validate PCI/PHI paths, 3) collect perf snapshot.

maria: can you also add a short mapping table in README: recommended instance_type vs expected qps for tiny/baseline models? partners always ask about sizing. even rough numbers help.

jules: yes — rough table + links to our perf profiles. I'll draft numbers: t4g.xlarge ~ 15 qps for tiny stub (intel/arm differences noted), g4dn.xlarge ~ 40 qps. will label as "very rough".

devon: who'll own the PR review? I can help with CI and examples.

jules: I'll open the PR by EOD and assign @maria for primary review, @devon for CI, and @ashok for security/KMS check.

maria: ack. can we add a short partner-facing one-pager (MD) that they can hand to their onboarding engineers? 3 steps, 10 min to run.

jules: yes — 1-pager + 5-min video (optional). i'll prototype the 1-pager in the repo root as PARTNER_QUICKSTART.md.

ashok: add note for partner teams: if they need a dedicated capacity demo, we can pre-provision a 24h dedicated node and attach sample token. include contact: partners@redwood.com.

marketplace-bot: CI workflow stub created: .github/workflows/stub-smoke.yml (integration, opt-in).

jules: sweet. action items: (1) jules: push branch + PR by EOD (2) maria: review README + partner 1-pager (3) devon: wire CI and smoke script (4) ashok: security/KMS blurb. i'll tag folks in PR.

maria: sounds good. thanks! :rocket: 

devon: will add a tiny terraform validate test and smoke harness.

ashok: reading the README draft now, will post comments on PR: security notes + KMS examples.

jules: thanks team — keeping this small will make partner enablement so much faster. will post PR link here when ready.

marketplace-bot: Pull request opened: https://github.com/redwood/refkit/pull/42 — title: "stubs/cloudpartnerx: lightweight terraform onramp + examples" — reviewers: maria, devon, ashok

jules: PR link received, i'll start shepherding reviews.

maria: got it. i'll review in the morning.

devon: will run CI smoke tomorrow and report back.

ashok: thanks — leaving a couple quick inline comments on KMS rotation and audit logging.

jules: end of thread for now — will update when PR merges. thanks everyone.
